notes: Line forms: {n} Feyre's narration, first person past tense, shown in italics; {s,e,t} a line spoken aloud (speaker, portrait expression, text); {hint} a game tip on its own card; {choices:[{t,goto,do}]}; {do:[actions]}; {goto}. Any line or choice may carry if_flag, if_not_flag, if_item, if_not_item or if_chapter. Wording is written for the game; the few short book lines kept are listed in quotes.json.

lines.n: A white mare waited at the tree line, unbridled, pale as new snow under the moon. She lowered her head as the beast went by.

lines.t: North, then. Toward them. To live with him, not die. Live.

lines.hint: Hold W to ride north behind him. Press E when you're close to speak to him.

lines.n: He didn't turn around. Fair enough. I'd killed his friend.
He hadn't answered the first time either.

lines.t: Would it matter to you, human?

lines.n: I opened my mouth to ask something else. He growled, and a sharp, metallic tang filled my nose.
Exhaustion slammed into me. Then nothing.
I woke with a jolt, still on the mare, held there by bonds I couldn't see. The sun was high. Birds darted past, and the air was mild as spring.
Ahead stood a gate of iron, set into a high green hedge.

lines.t: My prison or my salvation. I couldn't decide which.
